verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-facing retention settings, deletion API, or data-deletion workflow for Morph. The only related item is a community quote of the privacy policy describing tier-based data use (free tier may train, enterprise tier processes only the immediate request). That is a fixed policy tied to the plan, not a control the user exercises over retention or deletion, so it counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
